text:
maya: Heads-up from onboarding: a few folks hit friction because sample apps check numeric status codes directly (e.g. `if (err.status === 429)`), which led to brittle retries across languages. Can we agree on typed SDK errors + a concise retry_hint contract so the quickstarts teach the right pattern?

jon: Strong yes. Problems we see: 1) Retry-After header formats vary (seconds vs HTTP-date), 2) some endpoints include an explicit `retry_hint` in the JSON body, 3) `Retry-After: 0` semantics are unclear to users.

oliver: Suggested SDK surface: typed errors (RateLimitError, AuthError, PermissionError, ServerError, ClientError) + fields/methods: `retryHint` (enum: "no-retry"|"retry-after"|"exponential"|"refresh-token"), `retryAfter` (number|null), `httpStatus` and `raw` (original body+headers). TS/py should support instanceof checks; Go should expose interface methods `RetryHint() string`, `RetryAfter() time.Duration`.

sam: For mapping doc snippet for onboarding: 
401 -> AuthError (retryHint: refresh-token if bearer)
403 -> PermissionError (no-retry)
429 -> RateLimitError (prefer body.retry_hint; else parse header; else exponential)
5xx -> ServerError (exponential by default, platform may override)
other 4xx -> ClientError (no-retry)
Also be explicit: `Retry-After: 0` => retry immediately.

maya: Nice. Also request platform to standardize a new envelope for new endpoints: `{ code, message, http_status, retry_hint?, metadata? }` so SDKs can map fields without heuristics. If `retry_hint` exists prefer it over headers. Include `support_id` in metadata to help support.

jon: For SDK implementation details: parse `Retry-After` numeric strings and HTTP-date, accept `retry_hint` in JSON (values above), expose helpers `IsRetryable(err)` and `RetryAfterOrDefault(err, d)` in Go, and make tests cover numeric/HTTP-date/0/missing cases.

oliver: I'll open a Go PR that exports concrete error types and the helper funcs. Also add a small sample in sample-apps showing idiomatic pattern: `if IsRetryable(err) { time.Sleep(RetryAfterOrDefault(err, estimate())) }`.

ci-bot: ci/go-sdk #1345: tests/retry_test.go:18 failed -> expected RetryHint "retry-after" but got "none". https://ci.internal/redwood/go-sdk/1345

sam: Looks like the mock server in tests didn't include the header variant. oliver can you add test mocks for numeric, HTTP-date, and body `retry_hint`? Also test `Retry-After: 0`.

oliver: Yep, will add those. I'll also add a small linter rule in sample-apps that flags direct numeric status checks (`err.status === 429`) and suggests `IsRetryable` or typed checks. That should teach new users the right pattern.

maya: After merge we should update onboarding quickstarts for TS/Go/Py to use `instanceof RateLimitError` / `except RateLimitError as e` / `IsRetryable(err)` and show `err.retryAfter`. Small change, big DX win.

jon: One more nuance: sometimes model OOMs return 500 but are permanent. Recommend platform set explicit `retry_hint` for ambiguous 5xx where possible; SDKs default to `exponential` for 502/503 and `no-retry` for 500 unless overridden. Document this.

oliver: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/go-sdk/pulls/523 - typed errors + Retry-After parsing + helpers + tests.

ci-bot: merge pipeline started for PR 523.

maya: Thanks team. I'll track docs + sample-app updates. This should trim onboarding tickets. :thumbsup:
